# v0.6.18

## Changes

### Bug Fixes
- Fix "Check for update" not updating Header notification or Settings "Last checked" timestamp — app update state now shared globally via store

### UI / UX Improvements
- Display card title next to terminal session ID for easier session identification
- Remove redundant close button from terminal widget toolbar

### Refactoring
- Move app update state from local component state to global store for cross-component synchronization
- Clean up unused imports across multiple components
